description_en: Queries the Diversion from Origin Server configurations of one or more Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instances
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防（中国内地）实例的近源流量压制配置
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-block-status --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBlockStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
An array consisting of information about the IDs of the instances that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询近源流量压制配置的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_ids

StatusList.description_en: An array that consists of details of the Diversion from Origin Server configurations of the instance
StatusList.description_zh: DDoS高防实例的近源流量压制配置

BlockStatusList.description_en: An array that consists of details of the Diversion from Origin Server configuration

BlockStatus.description_en:
The blocking status of the network traffic. Valid values:

areablock: Network traffic is blocked.
normal: Network traffic is not blocked
BlockStatus.description_zh:
流量封禁状态。取值：
areablock：表示封禁中。
normal：表示正常（未封禁）

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the blocking. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 封禁结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒

Line.description_en:
The Internet service provider (ISP) line from which the traffic is blocked. Valid values:

ct: China Telecom (International)
cut: China Unicom (International)
Line.description_zh:
封禁线路类型。取值：
ct：表示电信海外线路。
cut：表示联通海外线路

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the blocking. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 封禁开始时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the instance
